Subject: MAP & legal sequencing for Gensys pilot (MSA / DPA / Order Form dependencies)

Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. As promised, I attached a working draft of a mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the pilot milestones, evaluation checkpoints, and the procurement/legal handoff points we typically see. High level notes: 

- Goal: pilot kickoff in Q3 with a 6-week evaluation window.
- Legal sequencing: we recommend an MSA review + parallel DPA review, then order form to lock pricing & term specifics before activation.
- Key gating items we expect from your side: SOC2 attestation dates, KYC for billing, and a purchase order or signed order form for committed capacity.

Can you confirm the procurement timeline on your side (estimated review cycles for legal + procurement)? If it helps, we can propose a compressed cadence and a one-week legal review SLA for the MSA/DPA if your team can commit to calendar slots for review.

Next steps I propose:
1) You share the ideal dates for legal/procurement review.
2) We finalize the MAP milestones and lock the order form pricing window.
3) Redwood legal (cc’d) will prep a redline-friendly MSA summary and expedited DPA template.

I attached: 20250722_gensys_map_v2.xlsx (MAP draft) and redwood_MSA_summary.pdf — both are editable.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao

Thanks Aditya —

Appreciate the clear MAP. High level from procurement/legal here:

- Procurement windows: we have a procurement committee meeting next Tue (2025-07-29) and one on 2025-08-12. If we can get an order form in draft by 2025-07-28, we can aim for signature in the 8/12 window.
- Legal review: usually 2–3 full business weeks for a non-standard MSA; if you can provide a redline-friendly summary and flag non-negotiables that would help accelerate.
- Security: full security questionnaire will need to be completed (we need SOC2 in the next 30 days or equivalent evidence).

Two asks from our side:
1) Please mark the MAP milestones that are hard deadlines vs. soft checkpoints (so we can map to internal gating).
2) Can Redwood provide an example order form populated with forecasted SKU/pricing for the pilot so procurement has numbers to review?

If your team can compress the MSA review to 1 week by taking the approach you flagged (summary + limited redlines), we can probably shift the signature to late July. Otherwise, we’ll be constrained to the Aug committees.

On the questionnaire: procurement@ and legal@ on our side will follow up; I cc’d procurement.

Best,
Elena

Elena —

Appreciate the fast turn. I’ve updated the MAP to explicitly label hard deadlines (pilot kick, acceptance cutoff, billing start) versus soft checkpoints (mid-eval health checks). See the attached v2.

To address your asks:
- I populated an example order form row in the MAP (SKU-level pilot forecast + proposed pilot discount) so procurement has tangible numbers for the 7/29 committee.
- Proposed sequencing (recommended):
  1) Week 1: Redwood provides redline-friendly MSA summary + DPA template (we’ll accept reasonable redlines; flag any restrictions on data processing we can’t change).
  2) Week 1–2: Gensys legal runs a parallel review of DPA while Redwood legal preps final MSA redline.
  3) Week 2: Order form drafted and routed for procurement approval; signature target 2025-08-12 (can be earlier if both legal teams align).

If GenSys can commit at least one legal attendee to a 60-minute alignment call this week (Thursday or Friday), we’ll table all major commercial/technical concerns and can often compress reviews by ~7–10 days.

Related links: HubSpot deal GS-2314 (linked below), and I added a Drive folder with templates.

I’ll coordinate an internal legal/solutions call and ask Laura to produce the minimal MSA summary we discussed. Ben — can you confirm whether we can offer a 10% pilot credit contingent on an 8/12 signature? If yes, I’ll include that in the order form to aid procurement.

Thanks —
Aditya
